ops.title: Fix-the-primitive wave: v14.3.0 primitives landed via 14.4.0 ancestry; 14.3.0 is a burned number
ops.body:
The 2026-07-19 fix-the-primitive wave landed three additive primitives, built and committed in an isolated worktree off trunk tip (commits 8bbe1e4 error fields → 5050c97 synthetic module → 5b1dc31 compositionality sweep → 61b5f64 release chore, tag v14.3.0):

1. Degraded-call 'error' field — Rust OtherCall.error: Option<String> (+ OtherCallView getter, excluded from view_dunders eq/repr/hash) and Python FallbackCall/FallbackResult.error (compare=False, repr=False). Contract: error is None ⇔ payload parsed as a mapping but the tool has no typed model; non-None carries the strict-parse failure message. Consumers can now distinguish 'genuinely untyped tool' from 'degraded parse' without re-parsing (capt-hook decisions.parse_degraded was the motivating consumer).
2. cc_transcript/synthetic.py — public promotion of the testkit builders plus synthetic_user_event/synthetic_assistant_event constructors that mint via native parse, so they satisfy the 14.2 events-in contract by construction. parser.parse_events(*lines) joined the parser facade. tests/testkit.py became a re-export shim (22 importers, zero churn).
3. Parse-compositionality contract — parse(prefix)+parse(suffix) == parse(whole) at any line-boundary cut, documented on parse_events_from_bytes and pinned by an every-cut sweep in tests/test_parser.py. Downstream incremental parsers (capt-hook transcache) now cite the contract instead of self-arguing it.

Release mechanics: the v14.3.0 tag's release run FAILED on the monotonic-version gate ('not greater than latest published 14.5.0') — a concurrent session had released 14.4.0/14.5.0 mid-wave from the same trunk. Verified by merge-base ancestry that 14.4.0 contains the full stack, so the wheel users get carries the primitives from 14.4.0 onward. 14.3.0 is a burned number: tag exists, no wheel was ever published under it. Do not reuse or delete the tag.

Adoption: capt-hook consumes all three (parse_degraded collapse, reason_kept via synthetic_user_event, transcache contract cite) in its fix-the-primitive ship — see the capt-hook wave note.
